subject: Vendor setup kickoff: Sage Systems — tax & PO checklist
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood-inference.com>
To: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@sagesys.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup kickoff: Sage Systems — tax & PO checklist

Hi Priya,

Welcome — glad to be kicking off the vendor onboarding for Sage Systems. To get procurement/finance set up so we can issue POs and get you paid, can you please complete the small checklist below and return the pieces listed in bold? If you have questions, reply here and I’ll loop in Finance/Legal.

1) Completed Redwood vendor onboarding form (attached) — please return filled PDF.
2) Federal tax form: W-9 (for US entities) or W-8BEN-E (for non-US). **Attach PDF**.
3) VAT registration certificate (if applicable). **Attach PDF**.
4) Bank details / voided check or bank letter for ACH (we will share a template if helpful). **Attach PDF or provide secure link**.
5) Remittance contact and preferred invoice email.
6) Company legal name and EIN / Tax ID that should be used on the PO and remit.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (fillable)

Target timeline: if we get the items above by end of this week (Fri 4/18), procurement can prepare a vendor record and issue an initial PO the following week.

Thanks — looking forward to working together.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Vendor Ops | Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference | vendor-ops@redwood-inference.com

Hi Priya — copying finance for visibility. A few follow-ups from AP before we can finalize the vendor bank record:

- Confirm legal entity exactly as it should appear on the PO/invoice (matching W-9).
- Please provide the last 4 digits of the EIN for verification; we will not publish full EIN in email.
- Complete and return the attached ACH_form_template.pdf with bank routing/account details or a bank letter on letterhead.
- Confirm remittance
default email for Redwood to send POs and for you to receive invoices (we usually set a single email).

Once we have the W-9 + ACH form or bank letter, and the onboarding form, we can create the vendor record and typically issue PO within 3 business days (assuming no legal review).

Attachment: ACH_form_template.pdf

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
